description: Read only which GetMattered account this connection is signed in as: the account id, the display name and the sign-in address. It changes nothing, sends nothing and spends no credits. Use it to tell two connected GetMattered accounts apart, and name the account to the user before acting on it. Do not use it for the plan, preferences or anything else; use getmattered_get_account.
name: getmattered_get_profile
title: Get Profile
